title: Bind no-capture completion attempt identity to an atomic run-feed cut
outcome: No-capture completion replay has an explicit atomic cut or documented seal-recovery contract under concurrent run-feed appends.
acceptance: A concurrent run-feed append between no-capture attempt identity and completion cannot make a committed success unreachable

completion.summary: Delivered by 1d04b09: the no-capture completion attempt key is derived from the base key plus the run-feed cut (completion_attempt_key), cut selection and append hold the SQLite writer slot in one IMMEDIATE transaction (completion_checkpoint_holds_the_writer_slot_across_cut_selection_and_append), a committed success replays by target (ensure_completion_replay_target) and refusals are never replayed, so a run-feed append between identity and completion recomputes instead of stranding a committed seal (pending_completion_resumes_after_holder_evidence_and_seals_the_current_set, capture_completion_replays_after_evidence_or_checkpoint_commit).
